blocks.html: Fourthly, during the three or four years that the accused and the said de Rols were together, she never complained of it; but on the contrary, when anyone said that the prisoner was not her husband, she roughly gave him the lie, assuring that it was Martin Guerre her husband, or some devil in his skin; and that she had known him well; and that if anyone were henceforth so mad as to say the contrary, she would have him put to death.
